summary: A horizontal ScrollArea with an always visible scrollbar holding a row of 24 Tag chips inside a glass card.
use: Overflowing chip, tag or filter rows that should scroll sideways instead of wrapping.
spec: `<Card material="glass" p="2" full>` wraps the area
`{ length: 24 }` builds 24 tags labelled Tag 1 to Tag 24, each rendered as `<Chip label={tag} />`
Chips sit in a `<div class="row">` styled with `width: max-content` so the content overflows
